result: Added pausing: an Escape-bound "pause" input action in `project.godot`, a hidden "Paused" label in `scenes/ui/hud.tscn`, and toggle logic in `scripts/ui/hud.gd`. The HUD runs in always-process mode so it keeps handling input and showing the label while the tree is paused. godot_review reports no errors; I could not run the game.
